verdicts.reason: Both crush all the supporting copy (tagline, green feature line, phone, website) into a right-hand column of type about 4px tall. At 320×50 it can't be read, and the right side is overstuffed while the headline floats on the left. A breaks the headline more evenly ('Traditional / Ceramics Workshop') and keeps its dash dividers clear. B leaves 'Workshop' alone on the second line, and its right column wraps one more line so it presses against the top and bottom edges.
